messages:
customer_josh: Hey team — running the POC ingest against rw-13b and hitting a hard error when we send ~11k tokens in the prompt. Getting `HTTP 413 Payload Too Large` and the call drops.
maria_sales: Ugh. Thanks for flagging Josh. @ajay_se can you pick this up? Customer wants to hit 10k+ context for a single convo.
ajay_se: On it. Quick Q — is this via the hosted API or Dedicated? Also which SDK and version?
customer_josh: Hosted API, using our node SDK v2.1.2 with a single POST to /v1/generate. Payload is JSON with messages array, pretty big. No retries.
ajay_se: Can you paste the exact error body and the request size (Content-Length) if available?
customer_josh: Error payload: `{"error":"Payload Too Large","status":413}`. Client logs show `Content-Length: 129874` and body size ~127KB.
ajay_se: That helps. Default hosted request size cap is 100KB (includes JSON overhead). Looks like we exceed it. Two options: chunk/context windowing or use a model variant with chunked streaming via the streaming endpoint. @taylor_eng can confirm the limits.
taylor_eng: Confirming: Hosted control plane enforces a 100KB body limit currently to protect frontends. The model KV/caching supports longer effective context via prefix caching but we don't accept single huge payloads in one call. We can either (1) accept batched/delta updates via session API, (2) switch to streaming + chunked messages, or (3) use Dedicated where we can relax the proxy limits.
erica_cs: For the POC timeline, customer prefers not to switch infra. Suggested immediate workaround: pre-summarize older context into a condensed system message and send only the recent 2-3 turns. That reduces size dramatically.
customer_josh: Summarization would lose some details we need to preserve for retrieval.
ajay_se: Another approach: use embeddings/semantic retrieval for long docs. Upload long docs to embeddings store, then fetch top-k snippets and pass them in the prompt. Keeps payload small.
customer_josh: Could you sketch a quick flow? We want to understand code changes.
ajay_se: Sure: 1) chunk long document into 2-5KB pieces -> call embeddings endpoint -> store vectors in your vector DB. 2) On generate call, embed query -> retrieve top 10 snippets -> concatenate + short metadata -> send in prompt. That keeps JSON <100KB.
taylor_eng: Also note: if you must send >100KB in single request, we can open a temporary exception for your account for the POC (needs ticket + security sign-off). It takes 48-72h to approve.
maria_sales: I'll coordinate the exception request if Josh wants it. @erica_cs can you prepare the POC exception template (data handling + justification)?
erica_cs: Yep. I'll need: a) sample payloads, b) expected QPS, c) data sensitivity classification. Send to me and I'll start the intake.
customer_josh: We can provide sample payloads. QPS is low during POC (0.2 qps). Data is non-sensitive internal docs.
ajay_se: Meanwhile, try a minimal repro so we can test locally: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @payload.json
payload.json should be <100KB. If it still errors, paste the full response and we can escalate. Also include request-id if present.
customer_josh: Will do and share results in this thread.
opsbot: IncidentBot: Rate limit & payload policy docs updated — see https://redwood.internal/docs/limits
maria_sales: Quick note on pricing: longer contexts via embeddings + retrieval typically reduces token usage since you avoid re-sending long transcripts. We'll send a cost estimate for the two approaches.
ajay_se: Action items: 1) Josh to post sample payload + client logs. 2) Maria to start exception intake if needed. 3) I will prototype a summarize+reduction script and post example.
customer_josh: Posting sample payload now.
customer_josh: (pastes truncated payload)
```
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"<very long system context ~8k tokens>"},{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}
```
ajay_se: Got it. I'll run quick test to validate where truncation happens and share a tiny repro script.
1755001460: thread closed by maria_sales: circling back once we have exception or reduced flow.
